name: Hiring Signals Intelligence
description: Web dashboard that surfaces genuine, matching IT job postings as soon as they appear publicly across multiple ATS providers
author: Teycir Ben Soltane

architecture.packages/domain: Zod schemas, shared types, role/provider taxonomies

completed: pnpm workspace setup
strict TypeScript base config
Prettier and shared ESLint base
Next.js 16 + Tailwind + TS scaffold
API client wired to Worker API
Hono Worker with middleware chain
cron scheduler stub and queue-consumer stub
role taxonomy and ATS provider enum
NormalizedJob/Signal/IngestMessage Zod schemas
full D1 schema with indexes
parameterized D1 client wrapper
signals/companies/facets repositories
API routes querying D1 for real
locationMode/country/source EXISTS filters on GET /api/v1/signals
opaque cursor pagination (score_desc/newest/company_asc) on GET /api/v1/signals
URL-safe UTF-8 cursor encoding (fixes InvalidCharacterError on non-ASCII company names)
signal_evidence(signal_id), signal_evidence(job_id), jobs(status,location_mode,country_code) indexes (migration 0002)
observedSince ISO-8601 datetime validation on GET /api/v1/signals
q free-text search (headline/summary/company name) on GET /api/v1/signals
try/catch around JSON.parse(payload_json) in getSignalDetail (degrades per-row, not 500)
toListItem enum validation via domain zod schemas (CorruptSignalRowError on bad data)
packages/domain eslint aligned to ^10.8.0 (matches root/db/api/adapters)
LIKE wildcard escaping in searchCompanies q filter (same class of bug as signals q, found during self-audit)
remote Cloudflare D1 database provisioned (hiring-signals, region EEUR) and migrations 0001+0002 applied and verified
remote KV namespace provisioned (CACHE) and wired in wrangler.toml
remote Queue provisioned (hiring-signals-ingest, producer+consumer) and wired in wrangler.toml
wrangler deploy --dry-run passes with all bindings resolved (DB/CACHE/INGEST_QUEUE/ENVIRONMENT)

R2 removed from the architecture entirely (was requiring Cloudflare billing/credit card) -- raw source-payload archive + export artifacts now live in CACHE KV under TTL-based keys (apps/api/src/services/raw-payload-store.ts), spec/README/AGENTS.md updated to match
migration 0003: renamed source_runs.raw_payload_r2_key -> raw_payload_key, applied and verified on local + remote D1
pending: wiring cron scheduler + queue consumer to real D1 queries
apps/web still on eslint-config-next -> eslint 9 chain (eslint-config-next hasn't caught up to eslint 10 yet; unrelated to domain fix)

features.export: CSV export of filtered signal list
features.ingestion: Cloudflare Worker cron triggers with adaptive cadence per provider

nonGoals: no collection of private profiles or personal data
no bypassing logins, CAPTCHAs, rate limits, robots directives
no general-purpose HTML scraping (official ATS APIs only)
no push notifications, email digests, or webhook alerting
no automated sending of cold email or LinkedIn messages
no claims about confirmed projects, budgets, or purchasing decisions
